usedFor: A “New Feedback Report” in Applivery adds the bug report to the reporter's HubSpot contact.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feedback Report” in Applivery, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A feedback report is the one Applivery event that comes from a person.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so the reporter needs a matching address in HubSpot.
